sections.section: 11.3 Diagnostic Evaluation for the Cause of ALI
content: Review of evidence for embolic events, risk factors, and outcomes in conditions like nonvalvular atrial fibrillation.
Impact of novel therapies and pharmacological agents on acute limb ischemia and related conditions.

sections.section: 11.2.2 Adjunctive Therapies to Minimize Tissue Loss in ALI
content: Multiple studies on risk factors and interventions to reduce tissue loss and improve outcomes in acute limb ischemia patients.
Includes findings from the National Trauma Data Bank and various randomized trials evaluating surgical and pharmacological interventions.
Focus on heparin-induced thrombocytopenia and its complications in the context of managing acute limb ischemia.
Discussion of different anticoagulant agents and their impacts on patient outcomes and safety.
